page_window_s.unit: seconds between two pages for one failing stage
page_window_s.source: Prometheus Alertmanager configuration, https://prometheus.io/docs/alerting/latest/configuration/, read 2026-11-11: 'How long to wait before repeating the last notification' [ repeat_interval: <duration> | default = 4h ]. The ranking Actor's pager repeats one stage's page at most once per this window (node_actor.py _fault).

receipt_interval_s.unit: seconds between two capacity receipt writes
receipt_interval_s.source: The existing deploy/monitor/systemd/parameters.json row monitor_bridge_period_seconds = 60 (OpenTelemetry Periodic exporting MetricReader, OTEL_METRIC_EXPORT_INTERVAL default 60000 ms), which already governs how often a measurement is exported to the monitor; the capacity receipt is that measurement's export.

status_snapshot_window_s.unit: seconds after subscribing in which a name's first status is counted as a snapshot
status_snapshot_window_s.source: No source found: the vendor's stream page does not state whether or when current status is sent on subscribe (LEAD-0020 1). There is no flag (lead ruling 04:2x): the recorder stays off.
